heroHeadline: NATO Assessed at Risk of Direct Conflict with Russia as Ukraine War Enters 'New Phase'
heroSubtitle: NATO has been assessed as at risk of direct conflict with Russia as the Ukraine war enters a new phase, per The Independent. The assessment raises concerns about escalation as the conflict continues into its fourth year.
